definitionZh: 边框-下方右射线CSS属性通过指定定义角曲面的椭圆半径(或半大轴和半小轴的半径)来包围元素的下方右角.
sourceDefinition: The border-bottom-right-radius CSS property rounds the bottom-right corner of an element by specifying the radius (or the radius of the semi-major and semi-minor axes) of the ellipse defining the curvature of the corner.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The border-bottom-right-radius CSS property rounds the bottom-right corner of an element by specifying the radius (or the radius of the semi-major and semi-minor axes) of the ellipse defining the curvature of the corner.
